2. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 31 st January, 2020.
Learned APP waives service for respondent-State.

3. Till next date, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.0605/2019, registered at Hingoli City Police Station, Hingoli, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of the Food, Safety and Standards Act, the applicant be released on executing P.
